summary: Candidate for Associate Director, ALM (18 Month Contract) with ~7 years across institutional ALM, IRRBB analytics, and balance-sheet risk. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs across multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, with hands-on EVE, NII, KRDs, and gap analytics under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks aligned to IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12. Advanced Python, SQL, and Excel; prior pension ALM and LDI delivery at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: SIRR / IRRBB Measurement & Reporting
bullets: Oversaw interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, producing EVE, NII, and key-rate duration (KRDs) outputs aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.

Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement — independently reviewed curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, reviewing consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Balance Sheet Analytics & Stress Testing
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking balance-sheet visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and hedging analysis.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.

sections.heading: Data Pipelines, Reporting & Executive Insight
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines feeding ALM measurement and reporting processes; SQL used for data extraction and aggregation across upstream data sources.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities — translating quantitative outputs into executive-ready narratives.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.
Led onboarding and implementation of the PFaroe analytics platform for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms — advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.

Translated client investment-team requirements into Product Owner development requests; contributed to the migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, advising actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on adoption.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes; developed advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral for IFRS 17 implementation.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Conducted LDI analysis and presented ALM findings to investment committees, including a three-plan university pension merger study evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
